payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure the accuracy of the confidence network, including the design of a confidence network that uses multi-layer hidden states and a confidence-based label smoothing approach.

claims.text: A confidence network was designed to predict confidence estimates using multi-layer hidden states of the decoder.
A confidence-based label smoothing approach was proposed to improve translation accuracy by adjusting label smoothing based on confidence levels.
Experimental results show that the learned confidence estimate outperforms traditional methods in separating good and bad translations.
